Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: System event code, see Event Code values

Message.Name: Stock Status Message
Message.Description: At the start of each Canada GLIMPSE transmission, Nasdaq will disseminate stock status messages for all symbols in Nasdaq execution system for the current trading day. The Symbol Status spin may include halted issues.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: H = Halted, T = Trading

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Listing Market
Field.Description: T = TSX, V = Venture, C = CSE, N = Neo

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Board Lot Size in Shares

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: CAD = Canadian Dollars, USD = US Dollars

Field.Name: GEF Eligible
Field.Description: Y = GEF Eligible, N = Not GEF Eligible

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that CXC or CX2 has accepted a visible order into the book. It includes a day-unique Order Reference key assigned to the order. The issuing of an Add Order Message is not necessarily always for a new order (see Modification of Existing Orders). Not applicable to CXD.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: Day unique order reference number

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order; S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered because part of the order may trade before being posted to the book).

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Message.Name: Long Form Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that CXC or CX2 has accepted a visible order into the book. It includes a day-unique Order Reference key assigned to the order. The issuing of an Add Order Message is not necessarily always for a new order (see Modification of Existing Orders). Not applicable to CXD. Long form messages are used when either the price or size is larger than the standard messages can permit.

Field.Name: Order Reference
Field.Description: Day unique order reference number

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order; S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered because part of the order may trade before being posted to the book).

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the order. Long form price: 12 whole number places followed by 7 implied decimal digits.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric TSX Broker Number or 001 for anonymous.

Value.Name: Start of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session
Value.Description: Start of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session

Value.Name: Start of Primary Market Trading Session
Value.Description: Start of Primary Market Trading Session

Value.Name: End of Primary Market Trading Session
Value.Description: End of Primary Market Trading Session. Indicates that Pegged orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. Nasdaq Canada is closed and not accepting orders. It is still possible to receive Broken Trade messages and Order Cancel Messages.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. Last message of the day.

Value.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt
Value.Description: Trading Halted due to Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Resumption
Value.Description: Trading Resumed following Market-Wide Circuit Breaker
